question: What sign indicates that sattva has increased?
premises: Knowledge arises as light in all gates in this body.
Then sattva is known to have increased.
inference: Increased sattva is recognized when knowledge-light arises in all gates of the body.
uncertainties: 'gates' may refer to senses or bodily openings; 'sattva' may be the guṇa or a being/state.
plain_english: When knowledge arises as light in all the gates of this body, then know that sattva has increased.
